scope: Full-frame stills/graphics and both single-page PDF renders inspected; original and final licensed Metro frames compared. Earlier batch media re-reviewed separately. Browser page rendering unavailable.

photo.title: Open bus doorway beside a curb in 2017
photo.alt: Metro bus 1617 with its front door open, yellow threshold edges and handrails, parked in a road beside a curb and a grass strip separating the sidewalk.
photo.caption: April 25, 2017 photograph of a Metro bus with its front door open. The view shows the threshold, handrails and road-to-curb gap; no ramp is deployed.
photo.author: Darius Pinkston
photo.limitations: Historical orientation only. This does not establish a designated boarding stop, a continuous sidewalk-to-door route, today’s fleet or trip assignment, ramp operation, boarding clearances, slope or assistance. A driver is faintly visible behind the windscreen. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP without changing the scene.

licensedPhoto.conversion: Sharp resize width 1280, no crop, WebP quality 88; original and final frame visually inspected

linkedGuides.title: Ramp-to-ground connection and vehicle interior
linkedGuides.description: Three operator photographs show a ramp meeting asphalt with yellow edge markings, another closer view of ramp boarding, and a vehicle interior with seats, rails, a walker and yellow step-edge markings. People appear in the original photographs. These are orientation views of pictured vehicles, not proof of today’s fleet, a particular trip’s equipment, ramp capacity, transfer help or a continuous pavement-to-seat route. The vehicle illustration on the page is excluded. Images remain with Metro; no reuse licence was found.
linkedGuides.documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

linkedGuides.title: Bond Hill and Roselawn zone orientation map
linkedGuides.description: One official map shows the Bond Hill/Roselawn service-area shape and named destinations. This is a map, not a photograph or a measured access route. It cannot establish pickup curb conditions or precise address eligibility. The page’s launched-zone heading and older future-tense FAQ differ; enter both trip addresses in the app or phone Metro before relying on the map. Original graphic remains with Metro.
linkedGuides.documentDate: Map publication/capture date unconfirmed; file path contains July 2026

linkedGuides.title: Mason entrance canopy and parking frontage
linkedGuides.description: One official frontage photograph shows glass entrance doors beneath a canopy, nearby accessible-parking signs and striped parking areas, planters and merchandise along the frontage, and stairs at the left. A grand-opening banner names August 20, 2025; the photograph’s capture date is unknown. Door operation, thresholds, parking-to-door gradients and an uninterrupted step-free route are not established. Original image remains with DLM; no reuse licence was found.
linkedGuides.documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

linkedGuides.title: Mason Culinary Center seating and doorway views
linkedGuides.description: Five useful views in the Mason gallery show tables with separate chairs, an aisle between table groups, a long counter with tall backless stools, ceiling lighting and large windows, and glass double doors with vertical pull handles. The six-image Mason gallery was inspected; a decorative glassware close-up adds no route information. Select the Mason location on the original page; Washington Square has a separate gallery. The images do not show the route to the mezzanine, an elevator, door controls or toilet facilities, and do not establish clearances or current layouts. No reuse licence was found.
linkedGuides.documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

linkedGuides.title: CRC lockers, track and exercise-room orientation
linkedGuides.description: Four facility photographs were inspected for orientation: a locker aisle with combination locks and an accessibility symbol on one locker, an indoor track with railings and an opening into the track area, a fitness area with equipment aisles, and a mirrored studio with a barre and large windows. People appear in some original views. These do not establish a locker’s usable dimensions, elevator routes, entrance controls, changing-room equipment, lighting adjustments or quiet conditions. A swimmer close-up is excluded. Original photographs stay with UC; no reuse licence was found.
linkedGuides.documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

linkedGuides.title: Leisure pool, lap-pool deck and hot-tub steps
linkedGuides.description: Three photographs show the lap-pool deck and lanes, the leisure-pool water channels and railed shallow entry area, and a raised hot tub with external steps and handrails. The hot-tub steps are a visible feature of that pictured approach; the images do not establish an alternative entry, an operating lift, transfer help or a continuous changing-room-to-water route. The zero-depth entry described in UC’s text applies to the leisure pool only. Original photographs remain with UC; no reuse licence was found.
linkedGuides.documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

linkedGuides.title: 2025 Uptown West Campus orientation map
linkedGuides.description: One-page campus map labels the Campus Recreation Center, surrounding buildings, parking garages and shuttle stops and includes wheelchair symbols. It is an orientation map, not a photograph or proof of current construction conditions. The visible legend does not explain every dashed line; no continuous step-free route, entrance designation, lift operation or gradient is inferred. Check the CRC’s main-lobby entry rule and current arrival arrangements. Original PDF stays with UC.

linkedGuides.title: Campus Green parking reader and HELP control
linkedGuides.description: Two original photographs show a Campus Green Garage entry terminal, its screen with a HELP control, ticket slot and red barcode reader; the second shows a hand holding a parking card below the reader. The images illustrate the scan-in procedure, not reachable heights, independent operation or a step-free route from the garage to the CRC. Capture dates and present hardware are unconfirmed. Images remain with UC; no reuse licence was found.

inspection.finding: Open-door 1617 selected; four others omit useful boarding detail or include obscuring passengers. SORTA and bus categories followed; photographer Flickr origin could not be read. Historical bus image establishes no current route or equipment.

Three boarding/interior photographs useful; one zone map linked. Vehicle cutout, Access vehicle rendering and announcement graphic excluded as documentary photographs. Larger duplicate Access interior downloaded but not separately counted as an inspected view.

Frontage plus all six Mason gallery views inspected. Glassware close-up excluded from five useful room views. Tall backless stools and glass pull-handled doors retained. JavaScript mas array maps six images to Mason, separate from wsq gallery; no mezzanine route inferred.
Four locker/track/fitness/studio and three pool/hot-tub views linked. Two swimmer-focused views excluded. Hot-tub steps visible; no inference of another entry, working lift or adult changing.
HELP control, screen, slot and barcode reader with scanning hand shown; reach heights and independent use unknown.
2025 campus orientation map linked, one page 521797 bytes. One-page fitness map with 2020 metadata inspected but held pending current-layout confirmation; two PDF pages rendered and inspected.
